Glory to the one who took his servant by night from the Sacred Place of Worship to the Farthest Place of Worship, whose surroundings we have blessed, so that we might show him some of our signs. He is the Hearing, the Seeing.
And we gave Moses the Book and made it guidance for the Children of Israel: "Do not take for yourselves anyone to rely on other than me,
descendants of those we carried with Noah." He was a thankful servant.
And we decreed to the Children of Israel in the Book: You will certainly cause corruption on the earth twice, and you will certainly rise to a great height.

So when the promise of the first of the two comes, we will raise up against you [alt: So when the promise of the first of the two came, we raised up against you] servants of ours who are fierce in battle, and they will go back and forth among the homes. And it is a promise that will be carried out.
Then we will give you back the turn against them, and we will supply you with wealth and sons and make you more numerous in men.

If you do good, you do good for yourselves, and if you do evil, it is for yourselves. So when the promise of the last one comes, it is so that they may bring grief to your faces, and enter the place of worship as they entered it the first time, and bring to utter ruin whatever they overcome.
It may be that your Lord will have mercy on you. But if you go back, we will go back. And we have made Hell a prison [alt: a mat] for the disbelievers.
This Quran guides to what is straightest, and it gives good news to the believers who do righteous deeds that for them there is a great reward,
and that for those who do not believe in the hereafter we have prepared a painful punishment.
And man calls for evil as he calls for good, and man is hasty.

And we have made the night and the day two signs. Then we erased the sign of the night and made the sign of the day give sight, so that you may seek bounty from your Lord, and so that you may know the number of the years and the reckoning. And everything we have set out in detail.

And every person, we have fastened his fate to his neck. [In Arabic the word for "fate" here is "bird", which is also the word for an omen.] And on the Day of Resurrection we will bring out for him a book that he will meet spread open:
"Read your book. Your own soul is enough today as a reckoner against you."

Whoever is guided is guided only for himself, and whoever goes astray goes astray only against himself. And no bearer of burdens bears the burden of another. And we would not punish until we had raised up a messenger.

And when we want to destroy a town, we command those in it who live in luxury [alt: we multiply those in it who live in luxury], and they are defiant in it, so the word comes true against it, and we demolish it completely.
And how many generations we have destroyed after Noah! And your Lord is enough as one who is aware of the sins of his servants and sees them.
Whoever wants the hasty life, we hasten for him in it whatever we will, for whomever we want. Then we make Hell his, to burn in it, condemned and banished.
And whoever wants the hereafter and strives for it with the striving due to it, and is a believer, those are the ones whose striving is thanked.
Each one we supply, these and those, from the gift of your Lord. And the gift of your Lord is not restricted.
Look how we have set some of them above others. And the hereafter is indeed greater in degrees and greater in setting some above others.
Do not set up another god with God, or you will sit condemned and abandoned.

And your Lord has decreed that you worship none but him, and do good to parents. If one of them or both of them reach old age with you, do not say "Ugh" to them, and do not scold them, but speak to them with gracious words.
And lower to them the wing of humility, out of mercy, and say, "My Lord, have mercy on them, as they raised me when I was small."
Your Lord knows best what is within yourselves. If you are righteous, he is forgiving to those who keep returning.
And give the relative his due, and the destitute, and the traveler, and do not squander wastefully.
Those who squander are brothers of the devils, and Satan is ungrateful to his Lord.
And if you turn aside from them, seeking a mercy from your Lord that you hope for, then speak to them with gentle words.
And do not keep your hand chained to your neck, and do not extend it to its full extent, or you will sit blamed and stripped bare.
Your Lord extends provision to whomever he wills, and measures it out. He is aware of his servants and sees them.
And do not kill your children for fear of poverty. It is we who provide for them and for you. Killing them is a great wrong.
And do not go near unlawful sex. It is an indecency, and an evil way.

And do not kill the soul that God has made sacred, except by right. And whoever is killed wrongfully, we have given authority to the one who acts for him, but let him not go too far in killing. He is aided.
And do not go near the orphan's wealth, except in the way that is best, until he reaches his full strength. And keep the covenant. The covenant will be asked about.
And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with the straight scale. That is better, and best in outcome.
And do not follow after what you have no knowledge of. The hearing, the sight and the heart, each of those will be asked about [alt: each of those will itself be asked about it].
And do not walk on the earth swaggering. You will not tear through the earth, and you will not reach the mountains in height.
In all of that, what is evil is hateful in the sight of your Lord.
That is part of the wisdom your Lord has revealed to you. And do not set up another god with God, or you will be thrown into Hell, blamed and banished.
Has your Lord, then, chosen sons for you and taken females for himself from among the angels? You are indeed saying a grave thing.
And we have certainly put it in many ways in this Quran, so that they may remember, but it only increases them in aversion.
Say, "If there were gods with him, as they say, then they would have sought a way to the Possessor of the Throne."
Glory to him! And he is high above what they say, by a great height.

The seven heavens and the earth and whoever is in them glorify him. And there is nothing that does not glorify him with praise, but you do not understand their glorifying. He is forbearing, forgiving.
